# git: alias: contribute command as alternative of at

Turn `git contribute` ([[DOT-319]]) into the everyday commit command, replacing the two-step `git at $(suggest) some message`. **Motivation:** "simplify interaction":

```bash
$ git at $(suggest) some message

$ git contrib some message
$ edit git contrib
multiline message
MSG
```

— a short name, the date obtained internally, and a way to give a multi-line message.
